observations.body: Malachi commands remembrance of Moses’ law at Horeb and promises Elijah before the LORD’s day to turn hearts across generations.
observations.label: The closing prophets join Horeb law and Elijah’s return

observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.

payload.posture: Read Malachi 4:4–6 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The closing prophets join Horeb law and Elijah’s return belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
